dossier.title: Recompense, steadfastness, prayer and moral repair (preliminary unpublished dossier)
dossier.chronological_background: Q11:111–115 closes the prophetic narrative sequence with recompense, steadfastness, prohibition of complicity, ritual prayer and patience.

source_table.comparison: Repentance and treatment of prior wrongdoing

dossier.similarities: Possible broad ethics of repentance and regular prayer.
dossier.differences: Ezekiel does not prescribe the Quranic prayer times; Psalm 55:17's three daily times do not correspond exactly to the Quranic formulation; neither demonstrates a source for Q11:114.
dossier.variant_witnesses: Hebrew Masoretic and Greek witnesses require checking; no manuscript dates authenticated.
dossier.dating: Composition, redaction, manuscript witnesses and modern translations must be separately dated before publication.
dossier.interpretations: Shared ancient Near Eastern religious practices or independent exhortation are alternatives to direct textual transmission.
